adapter_choices.evidence: norm_evidence + audit corrections verbatim from deney1_loco.py/race_sign.py load paths (read-only)

bootstrap.note: Only 10 clusters: interval is coarse; report raw effect + cluster count + explicit uncertainty caveat. No pooling, no familywise claims.
bootstrap.reps: resample whole archives with replacement, retain within-archive QAs

cohort.evidence_resolver: norm_evidence ids intersect id_to_row, dedup preserve order
cohort.exclusion_rule: category not in (1,2,3,4) excluded at load; valid = >=1 gold row after audit-corrected evidence resolution

float_baseline_disclosure: No frozen LoCoMo centered-float96 per-QA arrays exist in scope (race_sign_details/perq/peraxis npz are sign-only; filename search for *float*/*cos* in harness, audit_2026-09-13, round3, regen/locomo returned nothing). Centered-float96 R@3 is therefore a FRESH measurement by this runner (cosine on centered C/QC, frozen K/seeds/tie protocol, exact-equality float ties), gated by t=1 identity + FULL96 invariance + determinism, NOT by a frozen anchor. Sign baseline IS gated to frozen per-QA arrays.

float_convention.distance: neg_cosine (larger cosine = closer); rank by ascending distance
float_convention.gate_note: no frozen anchor; t=1 identity + FULL96 invariance + rerun determinism are the float gates
float_convention.score: cosine sim = (q.C)/(||q|| ||C||) on transformed rows; full norms recomputed after transform
float_convention.tie: exact float64 equality (==); NO invented tolerance
float_convention.zero_norm: if any row norm == 0 after transform, sim defined as 0.0 for pairs involving it (moot: observed min norms C 0.846 / QC 0.751, check at runtime)

checks.name: per-QA sign MC vs deney1_loco_peraxis.npz native
per-QA sign exact-exp vs taskC_LoCoMo_perq.json NATIVE96 exp
checks.note: audit notes <=5.6e-17 float noise on their side; cross-stack difference exposed not relaxed

checks.name: qid order vs perq qids exact match

float_gates: t=1 float exact == baseline float exact (bitwise)
FULL96 float: max rank/score deviation across t reported, scores within ulps
rerun determinism: gate quantities bitwise identical on repeat

groups.construction: per query, order coords by (abs(q_j), j) ascending via lexsort((j, abs)); LOW48=first48, HIGH48=last48. Gold-free.

intervention.recenter: none (do NOT refit/recenter SVD or recompute archive mean)
intervention.sign_note: positive t leaves all signs byte-identical (verify, not evidence)
intervention.transform: for group G and t: multiply BOTH doc coords and query coords in G by t; t=1 restores originals

also_report: fraction of QAs with any decreasing adjacent delta along ascending t (exact)
HIGH48 contrast + CI (predeclared comparison, not guaranteed control)
outcomes.primary: LOW48 endpoint contrast mean[delta_exact(t=4) - delta_exact(t=.25)] over 1535 valid QAs + archive-cluster bootstrap 95% CI; consistent-with-proxy-transfer iff CI excludes zero on positive side

protocol_note: PLAN.md copied byte-exact (6402 bytes) before any new outcomes; no protocol tuning after seeing outcomes. Exact expectation and 20-seed MC reported separately, never gated to each other.

retrieval.score: fractional gold recall = |top3 cap gold| / |gold|, mean over golds for exact-exp via MATH-1 tie law
retrieval.tie_rule: lexsort((priority, distance)) per trial; exact-expectation via per-gold (S,T) counts
